_note: The one input of release/example/run_example.py. The clip is NOT shipped: run_example.py downloads it from the pinned dataset revision and checks its sha256. Licence CC BY 4.0: redistribution allowed with attribution.

dataset.name: Video to Data (V2D) Challenge Dataset, Track 3 public split
dataset.attribution: Video to Data (V2D) Challenge Dataset, NVIDIA, CC BY 4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/video_to_data_challenge

camera.distortion: 14-term OpenCV rational model in meta/camera_calibration.json (k1 8.53, k2 10.92, ...)
camera.intrinsics: estimated per clip by MoGe-2 (the intrinsics stage), as for internet video; the factory K is not used
camera.why: the stored frames are upright (frame 0 viewed 2026-11-07: floor, table and hands at the bottom), so no rotation; Track 3 has no pinhole camera, and the repository has no undistortion step in its V2D path, so the frames go in as recorded
camera.distortion_at_box_px: 1-44 (box centre 12-16); left and right image edges about 205-259

task: Cup_Stack (episode 11): the right hand lifts the beige cup and stacks it into the blue cup
box_check: box_xyxy drawn on source frame 0 of the pinned clip and viewed 2026-11-07: it encloses the beige cup (the right marker ball is clipped at the box edge)
